focus_areas: Cephalofoil structural integrity and connection to body
Occlusion consistency between shark silhouette and sun glare
Realism of underwater lighting and silhouetting
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the junction where the hammer-head meets the main body. In AI images, this area sometimes shows unnatural blending or lack of definition. Also, verify that the shark's silhouette correctly blocks the sunlight behind it, rather than appearing semi-transparent or pasted on top of the glare.
image_description: An underwater shot looking up towards the surface, capturing the dark silhouette of a hammerhead shark swimming overhead. The sun is shining through the water on the left, creating strong backlighting and glare. The shark's distinctive T-shaped head (cephalofoil) is clearly visible in profile against the light. Several smaller fish are visible in the background near the surface.
